caption_follow.viewport: Fixed two-line-height viewport following its bottom anchor without scroll animation.

native_long_reading.scope: Installed native app, actual helper Fn events, physical microphone and real cloud inference.

short_diagnostic.scope: Production AppState in an isolated diagnostic host with in-memory history; real microphone, real cloud inference, production HUD and actual Messages insertion. Not the installed bundle or helper.

controlled_stall_diagnostic.scope: Production AppState in an isolated diagnostic host with in-memory history; real microphone, real cloud inference, production HUD and actual Messages insertion. Not the installed bundle or helper.

limitations: Single measured takes; no median/p95 latency guarantee.
First native model output still took 7.06 seconds after speech started; presentation changes do not remove ASR/network/context waits.
A separate diagnostic run used recorded-audio ASR fallback and took 12.49 seconds after Stop.
The first native recording included microphone consent; that interrupted insertion as designed and was excluded from performance claims. An initial diagnostic relay attempt failed and was excluded.
Native test used an unsent draft with an unrecognized recipient. OCR surfaced the real screenshot, but no automatic attachment or contact learning was claimed.
Raw footage, conversation contents, OCR text and timing points remain private and uncommitted.
